keyVerseDR: "One thing I know, that whereas I was blind, now I see." (Jn 9:25)

level1.title: Now I See!
level1.story: Jesus met a man who was born blind. He put mud on his eyes and said, "Go and wash." The man washed and could see!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus use to heal?
What are you thankful to see?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me see You. Amen.

activity.title: What happened first?
scenes: Jesus puts mud on the blind man's eyes
The man washes in the pool

level2.title: The Man Born Blind
level2.story: Jesus saw a man who had been blind from birth. He made mud, put it on the man's eyes, and said, "Go wash in the Pool of Siloam." The man washed and came back able to see! The Pharisees argued and threw him out, but he said, "I was blind, and now I see." Jesus found him, and the man said, "I do believe, Lord," and worshiped Him.
level2.keyLine: Whereas I was blind, now I see.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
level2.prayer: Jesus, Light of the World, open my eyes. Amen.

activity.title: Mirror message
activity.intro: Hold this up to a mirror, then copy it the right way.
activity.text: Whereas I was blind, now I see.
